name: Hooksmith
description: Generate, lint and fire-test lifecycle hooks for coding agents.

skills.name: hook-generate
skills.description: Generate a hooks block for a project from the recipe catalog, when a project has none or a harness is new.

skills.name: hook-lint
skills.description: Lint a hooks block against today's events and handler types, after any edit or when a hook does not fire.

skills.name: hook-fire-test
skills.description: Fire a hook with a synthetic event and read its decision, locally or in an E2B microVM, before trusting a guard.
